title: Grace, Lapse Warning and Reinstatement Terms — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Grace, Lapse Warning and Reinstatement Terms

The figures below govern what happens on a Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) policy when a premium goes unpaid, and on what terms a lapsed policy may be put back in force. They are listed for every coverage tier.

| Coverage tier | Grace period after a premium due date | Lapse warning sent | Reinstatement possible within | All premiums from the lapse date must be paid to reinstate | Proof of good health required to reinstate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | 60 calendar days | 30 calendar days after the unpaid due date | 5 years after the lapse | yes | yes |

## The same terms, read across the tiers

- **Grace period.** 60 calendar days after a premium due date before unpaid coverage lapses — on every tier.
- **Lapse warning.** Sent 30 calendar days after an unpaid due date — on every tier. The warning falls inside the 60-day grace period, since 30 is fewer than 60.
- **Reinstatement window.** 5 years after a lapse — on every tier.
- **Back premiums.** Reinstatement requires payment of all premiums from the lapse date — on every tier.
- **Health.** Reinstatement requires proof of good health — on every tier.

## Points of reference

- *Does a larger tier carry a longer grace period?* No. The grace period is 60 calendar days whatever the tier.
- *Can a lapsed policy be reinstated without paying the premiums missed since the lapse?* No. On every tier, all premiums from the lapse date must be paid.
- *Can a lapsed policy be reinstated without proof of good health?* No. On every tier, proof of good health is required.
